title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are working closely with our client to recruit someone analytical in this Accounts Assistant position. Sales Ledger and Customer Accounts

- Set up and maintain customer accounts, ensuring information is accurate and complete
- Carry out reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
- Review customer account activity and resolve queries or inconsistencies

- Support the transfer of existing project information from Sage 50 into Sage 200
- Assist with moving work-in-progress tracking from account numbers to project-based records
- Set up project records and allocate jobs and associated transactions correctly
- Review work in progress and investigate allocation or data discrepancies
- Help ensure customer accounts, project records and invoicing information remain aligned

Essential
- Strong practical experience of Sage 200, including system setup and supporting other users
- Proven experience in sales ledger, customer account administration and reconciliations
- A sound understanding of accounting processes and the ability to investigate discrepancies
- Confidence working with financial data, identifying issues and following them through to resolution
- A proactive, adaptable approach and the ability to work independently while supporting colleagues
- Strong attention to detail and clear communication skills
- An interest in a long-term, hands-on accounts and systems support role

Desirable
- Experience of Sage 50 and transferring information between accounting systems

title: Purchase Ledger
description:
An established business in Ripon is recruiting for a Purchase ledger to join their busy finance department.

You will beresponsible for maintaining an accurate and up-to-date purchase ledger, ensuring supplier invoices and credit notes are processed promptly, supplier accounts are reconciled, queries are resolved efficiently and payments are prepared in accordance with company procedures.

Duties:
- Accurately process and code supplier invoices and credit notes, ensuring they are recorded in the correct accounting period.
- Match invoices against purchase orders, goods received records and other supporting documentation.
- Obtain appropriate authorisation for invoices in accordance with the company's approval procedures.
- Review invoice coding, VAT treatment and supporting information before transactions are posted.
- Reconcile supplier statements to the purchase ledger and investigate any differences, missing invoices or unallocated credits.
- Respond promptly and professionally to supplier queries, maintaining positive working relationships.
- Liaise with depot teams, department managers and other colleagues to resolve invoice, pricing, delivery and approval queries.
- Prepare supplier payment runs for review and approval, ensuring payments are accurate and made in accordance with agreed terms.
- Allocate payments, refunds and credit notes accurately against supplier accounts.
- Monitor overdue supplier balances and identify invoices that are on hold, awaiting approval or subject to dispute.
- Maintain accurate supplier account details, including payment terms, contact information and bank details, in accordance with the company's verification and approval procedures.
- Support the creation of new supplier accounts and the amendment of existing records, completing appropriate checks before changes are processed.
- Assist with month-end purchase ledger procedures, including ledger reviews, accrual information and reconciliation of control accounts.
- Maintain clear and organised electronic records for invoices, statements, approvals and other supporting documents.
- Support audit requests by providing invoices, reconciliations, payment evidence and other purchase ledger documentation.
- Ensure all activities comply with company policies, financial controls and relevant VAT requirements.
- Provide general administrative support to the Finance team where required.
- Manage competing priorities effectively and meet daily, weekly and month-end deadlines.

Skills and Experience
- Previous experience in an accounts payable, purchase ledger or finance administration role is preferred.
- Experience of processing a high volume of supplier invoices accurately and within deadlines.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger processes, including invoice matching, statement reconciliations, credit notes and payment runs.
- Familiarity with VAT treatment and the importance of accurate invoice coding.
- Competent in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and comfortable using accounting or ERP systems.
- Strong numerical ability and a high level of attention to detail.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills when dealing with suppliers and colleagues.
- Able to investigate discrepancies, identify their cause and follow queries through to resolution.

Benefits
- Company pension scheme.
- Company sick scheme.
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays plus day off for your birthday.
- Life insurance x 3 salary.
- Tailored career path.
- Free on-site parking.
- Health and well-being support line.
- Employer funded Cash plan to support with covering employees' regular healthcare expenses.
